_doc: Games and competitions (docs/gdd/04f_vida_y_fiestas.md §4.26; contract: docs/contratos/juegos.md). Pure rules in sim/games/ (GameRules, one *Match class per game, Games is the API and the order game_play). Every roll is keyed (world seed | games | match id | step | what): a game never moves state.rng nor another roll. Nothing is saved: a game is played on its screen and sent whole in one order (the moves and whether the rest was resolved without playing); the sim replays it with the same keys and applies money and reputation. stakes: the stakes one may put (O-V8: at most cap per bet, also after doubling or raising). house.rake: the share of a table game's winnings (what the winner takes from the others) that a licensed gambling house keeps (O-V8: the house margin; 0 in the street). warn_loss: a day's net loss at games and bets that brings a warning. bets (04f §4.26.6): the bookmaker's odds = (1 - margin) / chance (the chance from `samples` automatic games), rounded down to `step`, within [min_odds, max_odds]; betting against oneself and losing having played is fraud seen with chance fraud_seen. loaded (O-V10 b): the item that are loaded dice; each rival notices them when a keyed d100 <= catch.base + (his empathy - the cheat's dexterity) x catch.step: the cheat loses the stake and the dice, a public fact «trampa» (justice charge cheat) and `reputation`. presets: the people who are not characters of the state (tavern regulars, outsiders): their stats and temper (temper: prudent | even | boastful | cheat; even = the AI policy that plays well). [balance]

azar._doc: «Azar» (Libro de los juegos, 1283; simplified): the thrower throws three dice. A first throw in azar (3-6 or 15-18) wins for the thrower. A middle number is the other's chance (suerte); the thrower throws again for his own: an azar number now is reazar and he loses (the rule of the Libro that makes the game fair: without it the thrower won 57 %), the other's number again is thrown again, any other middle number is his chance and then throws until one of the two chances comes: his wins, the other's loses. Once both chances are known each side may double once, the thrower first (the stake times 2, up to the cap); the other accepts (the game goes on at the double) or refuses (loses the stake as it was). The AI (and «Resolver sin jugar») doubles when its chance of winning is above double_at(rake) = 1 / (2 - rake) and accepts when it is at least accept_at(rake) = 1 / (2 x (2 - rake)), the thresholds that maximise the expected gold. max_throws: a safety stop (never reached in practice: then the thrower loses). loaded: the loaded dice of the thrower (04f §4.26.7, O-V10 b): on the first throw a die below `below` is thrown again; while throwing for the chances, a throw with the other's chance is thrown again with chance `again`.

mayor._doc: «Tres dados a la mayor»: 2-4 players put the stake; each throws three dice, two in sight of all and one under the cup (only its owner sees it). Then all decide at once: retire (gets back half the stake: loses half) or go on (puts the stake again: double or nothing). Of those who go on, the highest total takes the pot (ties share it); if only one goes on, he takes it without showing; if nobody goes on, all lose half. The odds on screen assume that everybody goes on: ganas = the chance of beating every other at once with their hidden die unknown. The AI (temper even, «Resolver sin jugar») goes on when the expected gold of going on is above that of retiring (-stake/2), prudent asks stay_margin more of the chance, boastful always goes on.

pulso._doc: Pulso (arm wrestling): three pushes, the one who takes two wins. Each push both choose push (empujar), hold (aguantar) or give (ceder): push beats give, give beats hold, hold beats push. The winner of the exchange tries to take the push (strength: base + (constitution - constitution) x step + advantage, the SkillCheck criticals); if he fails, or if both chose the same, the push goes by sheer strength (base + difference x step). Strength (fuerza): max = base + floor(constitution x per_constitution); push and give cost 1, hold recovers 2 (as the duel's breath: with push at 2 the AI could not answer a give and «always give» won 57 %); without strength one can only hold. The first push is blind; then the challenger leads (chooses first and his face gives him away: the reader sees a gesture true with read = base + (empathy of the reader - constitution of the leader) x step, clamped), then the other. AI: as the duel (answers the gesture with what beats it; leading, counters the other's most repeated action with chance habit once there are min_history, else a random action it can pay).

envite._doc: Envite (04f §4.26.8): two sides, 40 cards, three each, three bazas uncovered one after the other (the highest card of each against the other's highest, then the middle ones, then the lowest). order: the cards from the strongest down (the truc's: the four bravas, then every 3, 2, the other aces, king 12, knight 11, jack 10, the other sevens, 6, 5, 4); "*_n" = that rank of any suit not named before. Before each baza a round of raises (raise by the starting stake, raise again once, want or not), nobody over the cap. read: the gesture of a hand (pleased = it beats a random hand at least half of the times) is true with base + (empathy of the reader - rhetoric of who shows it) x step, clamped (two gestures: 0.5 would say nothing, so the base is 0.7, a reader as good as the other gets 7 in 10). ai: raise from raise_at (chance of winning counting the gesture), raise again from reraise_at, want from the chance where wanting pays, bluff below bluff_below with the temper's bluff chance.

tourney._doc: The fighting tournament (04f §4.26.2): a knockout of `size` with the duel (data/combat.json kind tourney: three rounds of three lances, a point a touch, no wound; tied, tourney_sudden; still tied, the judges). weapon: the tournament's (sword = the tournament sword, staff, fists; opts.weapon). Entrants: the player, the characters of other families with martial >= min_martial, then `outsiders` (presets). recover: breath the winner of a bout gets back before the next (it does not all come back). prize: the winner's purse and reputation (from outside, P4: the fiestas' sponsor adds his own by the event); finalist: the runner-up's reputation.

joust._doc: The joust (04f §4.26.1): two riders, three passes. Each pass each rider takes a stance: stances.<id>.aim is where his lance goes and .covers what his shield covers (the three make a triangle: one beats another when its lance finds the other open and the other's lance meets its cover). A lance at what the other does not cover hits with hit.base + (dexterity - the other's) x hit.step + aims.<aim>.mod: the helm unhorses (the joust is won), the chest gives 2, the shield 1; a covered aim gives its `safe` (the shield's half point), and a failed hit too. The first `blind` passes are blind; then the riders lead in turn (side 0 first) and the reader sees a gesture of the leader's stance, true with read (empathy of the reader against the martial of the rider; three stances, so 0.5 already tells). ai: as the duel's (answers the gesture with what beats it; leading or blind, counters the other's most repeated stance with chance habit from min_history passes, else at random). Equal after `passes`: up to `extra` more, then a draw. requires.title: who may enter (Ciudadano or more, or a noble); entry_fee: the horse and the tournament lance rented (D8: carts and horses with a cost; the carpenter's lance is a fiesta order). prize to the winner; favor: affinity with the one he courts most (the favour of a lady or a knight).

sortija._doc:
Correr la sortija (04f §4.26.3): 2-6 riders, `runs` runs each in turn. Each run the ring is one of `rings` (keyed per run; the value is the window's change). The rider chooses a pace (paces.: points if threaded, window = the hit's threshold, read = how reliable the sway of the ring is at that speed) and then the moment among three signals; one is right (keyed per rider and run) and the sway shows it, true with paces.

.read + (dexterity - 3) x read.step (clamped). At the right moment the hit passes with window + ring + (dexterity - 3) x hit_step. After the runs the most points win; equal, more rings; then a keyed roll. The numbers make each pace the best on one ring (dexterity 3): prudent on the small, firm on the medium, gallop on the large. entry_fee: the horse rented; prize to the winner. Anyone with a horse may run it (no title).

race._doc: The horse race (04f §4.26.4): `stretches` (the start, the straight, the mill's bend, the finish) against 3-5 riders. Each stretch every rider chooses a pace: paces.<id>.wind is what it costs (negative: recovers; a pace one has not the wind for cannot be chosen) and .factor the horse's speed it gives; a stretch covers speed x factor (x finish.press when pressing on the finish: the last push pays most) + noise x (a keyed roll in [-1, 1]). On the `risky` stretch a pace marked risky stumbles unless the rider passes stumble.base + (dexterity - 3) x stumble.step: the stretch then counts stumble.keep of itself. horses: speed and wind by horse (the rented one, `rented`, if the rider has none: D8 carts and horses with a cost). The longest run wins (equal: the faster horse, then a keyed roll). entry_fee: the rented horse; prize: the palio's worth (a silk cloth: the item waits for the fiestas' pieces) and reputation.

bulls._doc: Correr el toro (04f §4.26.5; O-V5 a: no wounds until 4.22's health, a failure is a fright and jeers): 1-4 mozos, `charges` each in turn. Each charge the bull charges, feints or hooks, keyed with its kind's weights (bulls.<id>.weights); its sign is true with read.base + (dexterity of the mozo - bulls.<id>.bravery) x read.step (clamped). payoff.<action>.<bull's action>: the applause (a failure is negative). The most applause wins (equal: fewer failures, then a keyed roll). For the played side's family: reputation rep_per_break for each quiebro, rep_per_fail for each failure (the jeers) and the emotion scared; the winner, prize. bull: the default (the fiestas pass opts.bull).
